name: PageProtectPro
author: pageprotectpro

sections.description:
PageProtectPro is the simple way to protect WordPress pages and websites with password protection.

Protect individual pages, your entire website, or private content areas without the complexity of a membership plugin. PageProtectPro is designed for website owners, agencies and administrators who want a clean, fast and professional way to restrict access to selected WordPress content.

Included Features

  • Whole-site password protection
  • Unlimited individual page and post protection
  • Role-based bypass controls
  • Lock-screen text customisation
  • Lock-screen colour customisation
  • Professional visitor-facing lock screen
  • Protect Page quick action from the WordPress Pages list

Common Uses

PageProtectPro is ideal for:

  • Websites under construction
  • Client review websites
  • Staff documents and internal resources
  • Company policies, manuals and guides
  • Private pages and restricted content
  • Training materials
  • Simple client portals
  • Staging websites

Why Choose PageProtectPro?

Many content protection plugins are built around complex membership systems. PageProtectPro focuses on one thing: simple, reliable password protection for WordPress pages and websites.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for PageProtectPro.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.
  6. Go to Settings > PageProtectPro.
sections.faq:
Can I protect my entire website?

Yes. Whole Site Protection is included.

Can I protect individual pages?

Yes. You can password protect unlimited individual pages and posts.

Can logged-in users bypass protection?

Yes. Role-based bypass controls allow selected WordPress user roles to bypass protection.

Does PageProtectPro stop Google indexing protected content?

Protected content is not accessible without the password and the lock screen uses noindex meta tags.

Can I use PageProtectPro for staff documents and internal resources?

Yes. PageProtectPro is suitable for staff handbooks, company policies, internal procedures, training materials and client documentation.
